no-restricted-syntax.message: String.prototype.replaceAll is ES2021 (Chrome 85+). The iMin POS WebView is Chrome 80-84 -- use .replace(/x/g, ...) instead. See DGFY-POS-B.
Array/String.prototype.at is ES2022 (Chrome 92+). The iMin POS WebView is Chrome 80-84 -- use indexed access (arr[arr.length - 1]) instead. See #664 / #666.
Array.prototype.findLast is ES2023 (Chrome 97+). The iMin POS WebView is Chrome 80-84 -- use a reversed loop or [...arr].reverse().find(...) instead. See #666.
Array.prototype.findLastIndex is ES2023 (Chrome 97+). The iMin POS WebView is Chrome 80-84 -- use a reversed loop instead. See #666.
Object.hasOwn is ES2022 (Chrome 93+). The iMin POS WebView is Chrome 80-84 -- use Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(obj, prop) instead. See #666.
structuredClone is Chrome 98+. The iMin POS WebView is Chrome 80-84 -- use JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(x)) or a manual deep clone instead. See #666.
Array.prototype.toSorted is ES2023 (Chrome 110+). The iMin POS WebView is Chrome 80-84 -- use [...arr].sort(...) instead. See #666.
Array.prototype.toReversed is ES2023 (Chrome 110+). The iMin POS WebView is Chrome 80-84 -- use [...arr].reverse() instead. See #666.
Array.prototype.toSpliced is ES2023 (Chrome 110+). The iMin POS WebView is Chrome 80-84 -- use [...arr] then .splice(...) on the copy instead. See #666.
Object.groupBy is Chrome 117+. The iMin POS WebView is Chrome 80-84 -- use array.reduce(...) instead. See #666.
Map.groupBy is Chrome 117+. The iMin POS WebView is Chrome 80-84 -- use array.reduce(...) instead. See #666.
AbortSignal.timeout is Chrome 103+. The iMin POS WebView is Chrome 80-84 -- use a manual AbortController + setTimeout instead. See #666.
